import html from typing import List # Example template; in real usage this would be defined elsewhere. USER_POST_FORMAT = """

{title}

by {author}

{body}
{tags}
""" def generate_post_html(author: str, title: str, body: str, post_tags: List[str]) -> str: """ Generate a sanitized HTML representation of a forum post. Parameters ---------- author : str The author's name. title : str The post's title. body : str The main content of the post. post_tags : list[str] List of tags associated with the post. Returns ------- str A string containing sanitized HTML ready to be served. Notes ----- All user-supplied content is escaped using html.escape to prevent cross‑site scripting (CWE-79). Tags are rendered as individual elements with the class "tag". """ # Escape user input to neutralize HTML special characters safe_author = html.escape(author, quote=True) safe_title = html.escape(title, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(body, quote=False) # Render tags safely escaped_tags = [ f'{html.escape(tag, quote=True)}' for tag in post_tags ] tags_html = " ".join(escaped_tags) # Populate the template return USER_POST_FORMAT.format( author=safe_author, title=safe_title, body=safe_body, tags=tags_html )
